Lower Text: [All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by your effects, from its digivolution cards, return 1 Digimon card to the hand and place 1 [X Antibody] as your top security card.
Upper Text: While you have a Digimon, you may ignore this card's color requirements.

[Main] 1 of your Digimon without [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [X Antibody] trait in your hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 1. If it did, place this card as its bottom digivolution card.
